description: Source code for the UploadDataStream class in the net namespace, implementing data streaming functionalities including initialization, reading, resetting, and progress tracking.

classes.name: UploadDataStream
classes.description: Class managing upload data stream, including initialization, reading, resetting, and progress reporting.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the upload data stream, setting up necessary resources and logging.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, handling asynchronous callbacks.

methods.name: IsEOF
methods.description: Checks if the end of the data stream has been reached.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream state, aborting pending operations and clearing internal state.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Sets the total size of the data to be uploaded.

methods.name: SetIsFinalChunk
methods.description: Marks the current chunk as the final one in chunked transfer.

methods.name: IsInMemory
methods.description: Indicates whether the data stream is stored in memory (returns false).

methods.name: GetElementReaders
methods.description: Returns element readers for the data stream (returns nullptr).

methods.name: OnInitCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of initialization, updating state and logging.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, updating position and EOF status.

methods.name: GetUploadProgress
methods.description: Returns current upload progress including bytes uploaded and total size.

methods.name: AllowHTTP1
methods.description: Indicates if HTTP/1.1 is allowed (returns true).
